# Harichand Steel

> Harichand Steel is a premier architectural metal fabrication company headquartered in New Delhi, India. Established in 2004, the firm specializes in engineering aluminium profile gates, certified SS304 stainless steel main gates, high-security steel doors, wrought iron gates, and motorized entrance automation systems across Delhi and Delhi NCR.

Official Website: https://harichandsteel.com/  
Markdown Documentation Hub: https://harichandsteel.com/markdown/  
Primary Headquarters & Workshop: 27B, Street, New Jankipuri, Anup Nagar, Uttam Nagar, Bindapur, New Delhi, Delhi, 110059, India  
Direct Telephone: +91 98704 33868  
Official Email: Admin@HARICHANDSTEEL.COM

---

## Business & Manufacturing Overview

- **Two Decades of Excellence:** Established in 2004, delivering custom gates for 10,000+ luxury villas, bungalows, residential societies, and commercial properties.
- **In-House Workshop:** Direct factory fabrication in Uttam Nagar, New Delhi equipped with high-precision fiber CNC laser cutters, argon-shielded TIG welders, and electrostatic powder coating booths.
- **Certified Raw Materials:** Exclusively authentic SS304 grade austenitic stainless steel (18% Cr, 8% Ni) and architectural 6063-T6 aluminium alloy extrusions.
- **Smart Gate Automation:** Engineered for compatibility with Italian motorized swing and sliding operators (Sommer, Nice, BFT) and optical biometric fingerprint locks with Tuya mobile app integration.
- **Service Footprint:** Complete doorstep site measurement, CAD customization, and turnkey installation across Delhi, Janakpuri, Dwarka, Gurugram, Noida, and the entire Delhi NCR.

## Technical Specifications & Engineering Standards

- **Aluminium Profile Gates:** High-tensile 6063-T6 extruded alloy; 60% lighter than solid iron; zero rust formation; compatible with wood-grain powder coating, fluted glass, and rose gold handles.
- **Stainless Steel Main Gates:** Certified SS304 austenitic alloy; 18% chromium, 8% nickel; full resistance to outdoor monsoon corrosion; polished mirror or satin hairline finishes.
- **CNC Laser Cutting:** Computer-controlled fiber laser profiling delivering burr-free cuts into heavy steel sheets for modern geometric, botanical, and custom family motifs.
- **Security Steel Doors:** Double-skinned steel security panels with internal acoustic insulation, weatherstripping, and multi-point mortise deadbolts.
- **Gate Motorization:** Heavy-duty reinforced base tracks and cantilever bearings built to interface with Italian automation motors (Sommer, Nice, BFT) supporting remote keyfobs, RFID sensors, and mobile apps.
